title: Title & Registration Services Late-Registration Penalty Rate Bands by Days Late
content:
For a late-registration penalty on a Title & Registration Services order, the penalty's days late are the calendar days from the order's opening date to the penalty filing date, less the registration state's dealer deadline days from the state dealer deadline schedule, and never below zero. The penalty rate is four tenths (0.40) when the penalty's days late exceed thirty, two tenths (0.20) when they are eight to thirty, and the standard twelve hundredths (0.12) otherwise. The rate is applied to the sum of the title fee and the registration fee collected on the order.

## State dealer deadline schedule

| Registration state | AZ | TX | GA | FL | NC | OH | PA | CO |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dealer deadline days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 28 | 30 | 20 | 30 |

## Rate bands

| Penalty's days late | Penalty rate |
|---|---|
| more than 30 | 0.40 |
| 8 to 30 | 0.20 |
| 0 to 7 | 0.12 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Days late | Rate |
|---|---|
| 7 | 0.12 |
| 8 | 0.20 |
| 30 | 0.20 |
| 31 | 0.40 |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A PA order opened 1 March with a penalty filing date of 5 April: 35 calendar days, less PA's 20 dealer deadline days, gives 15 days late, so the rate is 0.20. On collected title and registration fees of 112.00 the rate yields 22.40.
